tools.name: list_user_lists
tools.description: List the shopping lists the current user can access. Use this when you need to discover available lists before acting on one.

include_items.description: Whether to include the current items of each list.

include_collaborators.description: Whether to include collaborators for each list.

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return.

tools.name: get_list_details
tools.description: Get the full details of a shopping list the current user can access, including items, recipes, owner, and collaborators.

list_id.description: The id of the target shopping list.

tools.name: find_list_by_name
tools.description: Find accessible shopping lists by exact or partial name. Use this when the user refers to a list by name instead of id.

query.description: The full or partial list name to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a new shopping list for the current user.

name.description: The name of the new list.

color.description: The visual color label used by the list.

date.description: Optional date for the list in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Update the basic fields of an accessible shopping list.

list_id.description: The id of the list to update.

name.description: The new name of the list.

color.description: The new color of the list.

date.description: The new date of the list in YYYY-MM-DD format.

list_id.description: The id of the list to delete.

tools.name: add_list_item
tools.description: Add a manual item to a shopping list.

list_id.description: The id of the target list.

quantity.description: Optional numeric quantity for the item.

checked.description: Whether the item starts as checked.

tools.name: update_list_item
tools.description: Update a manual shopping-list item, including its checked state.

item_id.description: The id of the item to update.

tools.name: remove_list_item
tools.description: Remove an item from a shopping list.

item_id.description: The id of the item to remove.

tools.name: add_recipe_to_list
tools.description: Attach a recipe to a shopping list and merge its ingredients into the list items.

list_id.description: The id of the target list.

recipe_id.description: The id of the recipe to attach.

servings.description: Optional custom servings for the recipe in this list.

tools.name: update_recipe_servings_in_list
tools.description: Update the servings of a recipe already linked to a shopping list and recalculate merged ingredients.

list_id.description: The id of the target list.

recipe_id.description: The id of the linked recipe.

tools.name: remove_recipe_from_list
tools.description: Remove a linked recipe from a shopping list and subtract its merged ingredients when possible.

list_id.description: The id of the target list.

recipe_id.description: The id of the linked recipe to remove.

tools.name: list_list_members
tools.description: List the owner and collaborators of a shopping list the current user can access.

list_id.description: The id of the target list.

tools.name: find_friend_by_name
tools.description: Find one of the current user's friends by exact or partial username.

query.description: The full or partial username to search among the current user's friends.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: find_group_by_name
tools.description: Find one of the current user's friend groups by exact or partial name.

query.description: The full or partial group name to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: share_list_with_friend
tools.description: Share a shopping list with one friend who is already connected to the current user.

list_id.description: The id of the list to share.

friend_user_id.description: The id of the friend who should receive access.

tools.name: share_list_with_group
tools.description: Share a shopping list with all members of one of the current user's friend groups.

list_id.description: The id of the list to share.

group_id.description: The id of the friend group whose members should receive access.

tools.name: unshare_list_with_friend
tools.description: Remove one collaborator from a shopping list. Only the list owner can do this.

member_user_id.description: The id of the collaborator to remove.
